title: Nutritious Energizing Andalusian Chestnut Mushroom Paella
description: Energizing Spanish paella dish featuring chestnut mushrooms, with a caramelized twist. Suitable for diabetics.

ingredients.name: Sherry vinegar
ingredients.notes: For a slightly sweet and tangy taste

instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start browning, about 5 minutes.
Add the chorizo slices and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the rice, smoked paprika, sherry vinegar, salt, and black pepper. Stir-fry the mixture for 2-3 minutes.
Add 450ml of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Stir-fry the paella for 2-3 minutes to create a crispy crust at the bottom.
Serve hot and garnish with parsley or lemon wedges.
